# api.storyboards.sgit.ai

> The storyboard kit: draws storyboards (JSON) as sketchy SVG panels in the browser, served in immutable versioned folders. Current release v0.1.0 at https://api.storyboards.sgit.ai/v0/v0.1/v0.1.0/ (manifest: https://api.storyboards.sgit.ai/v0/v0.1/v0.1.0/manifest.json). Site v0.1.0.

Every page has a markdown twin: replace .html with .md.
